title: Weather Gesture · Quick round
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Weather Gesture · Quick round with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Write familiar weather conditions on slips. The lead silently shows how someone might react to one selected condition. Another player guesses the weather condition. Give each attempt 30 seconds. Each player leads two turns and earns one point per success. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: Paper and pencil; a timer.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Weather Gesture, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
Another player guesses the weather condition.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: Another player guesses the weather condition.
